verdict: Plays clean: cleared, no console error, every spot reachable; the rival (Silvane), the trial (a horde), the ruler (the Bell Below; the bot lost the first try and won the second, as a person may) and the gate (Kaia) all played.

found.title: Rulers that are not people in the Codex wear a person's figure
found.text: The Codex: the Bell Below is “the harbour's old bell ... It rings underwater”; floor 7 draws it with the Tide Judge's model (a robed figure). The same on floor 8 (the Lantern Leviathan, “a great fish”, in the Judge's figure) floor 17 (the Lantern Root, a root with an amber lantern, in the Antler King's stag figure), floor 18 (the Grey Oak, a dead oak that walks, in the same) and floor 19 (the Mire Heart, a bog, in the Thorn Mother's figure). The ruler models' floors were left to you when they were made; either the Codex says these rulers are people (the bell's ringer, the Leviathan's keeper...), or these floors get rulers of their own (Blender, one at a time).
